entities.summary: "I Should Be So Lucky" is a 1987 song performed by Australian singer and songwriter Kylie Minogue from her debut album, Kylie (1988). Released on 29 December 1987 by Mushroom Records and PWL Records, the song became a worldwide breakthrough hit. The image of Minogue on the front cover of the single was shot by David Levine. The song was written and produced for Minogue by Stock Aitken Waterman, who went on to produce Minogue's initial four albums.
